references.label: Left eject
references.description: Under-flipper eject that advances Jetpack and can start Bond, James Bond.
references.context: The left eject advances Jetpack and can start the mini-wizard multiball.

references.label: Left ramp
references.description: Jetpack start, double-jackpot, and several mode shot.
references.context: The left ramp starts and advances Jetpack Multiball.

references.label: Center lane
references.description: Bird One lock lane and Jetpack hurry-up collect.
references.context: The center lane locks Bird One balls and sets Jetpack's jackpot value.

references.label: Right ramp
references.description: Villain start and Bond, James Bond start shot.
references.context: The right ramp starts Villain modes and the mini-wizard multiball.

references.label: Side ramp
references.description: Henchman start and Bond, James Bond Super Jackpot shot.
references.context: The side ramp starts Henchmen and collects the mini-wizard Super Jackpot.

references.label: Upper loop
references.description: Upper-flipper loop used to collect qualified Bond Women.
references.context: The upper loop collects lit Bond Women.

references.label: Osato rocket targets
references.description: Three targets that qualify Bird One locks and raise its jackpot base.
references.context: The rocket targets qualify Bird One and increase its Jackpot values.

references.label: Bird One rocket
references.description: Center rocket shot used for Bird One locks and Super Jackpots.
references.context: The rocket collects Bird One locks and Super Jackpots.

references.label: Dragon Tank target
references.description: Premium and LE Jetpack Super Jackpot target with a direct-drain return.
references.context: The Dragon Tank collects the Premium or LE Jetpack Super.
